card.text: Omega Centauri is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 5,426 parsecs away. That published distance locates the cluster, not its individual stars.

sources.label: Baumgardt & Vasiliev (2021), Accurate distances to Galactic globular clusters through a combination of Gaia EDR3, HST and literature data, Table 2, NGC 5139: combined distance 5.426 +/- 0.047 kpc. Full downloaded paper bytes.
